text:
The last 500 m to the Kittilä site is unploughed in winter. This was reported at the Kittilä site, device not confirmed, with low confidence (0.25) from Tiina Tuominen (teams, 2026-04-16).

1. Park at the snowmobile track sign and walk the last 500 m.
2. Use the snowshoes located on the left wall inside the equipment container.
3. Open the container padlock with code 6142.
